talks.title: Policy Village Overview
talks.teaser: Welcomes attendees to DEF CON 32 Policy Village with an overview of what to expect from the track.
talks.summary:
A concise video overview of the DEF CON 32 Policy Village, introducing attendees to the intersection of cybersecurity research and public policy.

The host outlines the village's schedule, featuring discussions with state, federal, and international policymakers, White House cyber officials, and civil society advocates. Attendees are invited to participate in policy challenges, discuss emerging AI security regulations, and earn a special White House challenge badge.
